summary:
Abandoned But Not Forgotten is an interactive scrollytelling website that teaches kids ages 5-10 about the NASA hardware left behind on the Moon and Mars. Guided by T.R.I.O., a three-headed rover robot narrator, visitors travel from Earth to the Moon to Mars to meet all of the space equipment. Along the way, eight instruments introduce themselves with a kid-friendly fact, then open into a popup with more detail and a 3D model that kids can rotate 360° by dragging. An AI voice-over reads the story aloud so young readers can follow along.

The project answers the challenge by turning abandoned space hardware into characters with their own stories, rather than leaving them as forgotten objects. It matters because it helps young learners see space exploration as an ongoing story and builds curiosity about the machines that made future missions possible. Our message: left behind doesn’t mean forgotten.
details:
• 🚀 Details

Abandoned But Not Forgotten is an interactive scrollytelling website for kids ages 5-10, told from the point of view of the NASA hardware left behind on the Moon and Mars. Our narrator, T.R.I.O. (The Robotic Interplanetary Observer), is a rover robot with three camera heads: an enthusiastic host, a curious scientist, and a dramatic sidekick. T.R.I.O. guides visitors through four chapters (Earth, the Moon, Mars, and a happy ending) as eight instruments introduce themselves with a kid-friendly fact. Kids can click each one for more detail and drag to rotate its 3D model 360°. An AI voice-over reads the story aloud, and the journey ends with one message: left behind doesn’t mean forgotten.

🛰️ The Eight Explorers

  • Moon: Apollo Lunar Modules, Lunar Roving Vehicles, ALSEP science packages, Surveyor landers
  • Mars: Sojourner, Spirit & Opportunity, Phoenix & InSight, Kepler Space Telescope

💻 Tech Stack

  • Built with Lovable, version-controlled on GitHub
  • Interactive 3D viewer using models from NASA’s 3D Resources library
  • Original cartoon illustrations of T.R.I.O. narrator
  • Using Claude to generate the rest of the space equipment illustrations
  • ElevenLabs for our AI-generated voice-over narration
  • Gemini, to help us create kid-friendly sentences about each space equipment

✨ Innovation Highlights

  • 📖 Narrative Design: A four-chapter scrollytelling journey where the hardware becomes the storyteller
  • 🔭 Educational Value: Each instrument shares one simple fact, then offers a deeper popup
  • 🎨 Kid-Friendly Interaction: Everything works by scrolling, clicking, or dragging, with no instructions needed
  • 🔊 Accessible Format: Includes a voice-over helps pre-readers follow along
  • 👧 Built With Our Audience: An elementary school student on our team helped shape the storyline and plot
  • 📡 Data Trust: 3D models and scientific references sourced directly from NASA
